- **Ounass** (premium beauty + luxury gifting, fast delivery in UAE/KSA)
- **Namshi** (good deals and popular brands, especially in UAE/KSA)
- **Faces / Wojooh** (regional beauty retailer, often strong on sets and promos)
- **Amazon.ae / Amazon.sa** (convenient, but stick to “sold by Amazon” or authorized sellers for authenticity)
